_note: Reference documentation only. Not loaded at runtime — modules/gcp_checks.py is the source of truth for check logic. Keep this file's rule list in sync with the classes implemented there; do not list rules that have no corresponding check class.
benchmark: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundations Benchmark

rules.title: Ensure User-Managed Service Account Keys are rotated every 90 days or less
rules.rationale: Service account keys do not automatically expire. Stale keys exposed in source code or backup files create long-term persistent backdoor access.
rules.remediation: Delete old key IDs and rotate to new service account keys using gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete.

rules.title: Ensure Primitive Roles (Owner/Editor) are not used for service accounts
rules.rationale: Primitive roles grant blanket read/write/delete privileges across all resources in a GCP project.
rules.remediation: Replace roles/owner and roles/editor with predefined, least-privileged IAM roles.

rules.title: Ensure no VPC Firewall rules allow unrestricted 0.0.0.0/0 ingress to SSH (22)
rules.rationale: Exposing SSH globally invites automated brute-force attacks and zero-day exploitation.
rules.remediation: Modify firewall rule sourceRanges to trusted corporate IP blocks or use Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP).

rules.title: Ensure no VPC Firewall rules allow unrestricted 0.0.0.0/0 ingress to RDP (3389)
rules.rationale: Remote Desktop Protocol exposed to the internet is heavily targeted for ransomware deployment.
rules.remediation: Restrict RDP ingress rules or mandate VPN / IAP desktop access.

rules.title: Ensure Cloud Storage Buckets do not allow public allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers read/write
rules.rationale: Public GCS buckets expose proprietary source code, credentials, and customer PII to unauthorized internet scraping.

rules.title: Ensure Cloud SQL Instances do not have public IPv4 addresses assigned
rules.rationale: Direct public IP assignments to databases increase attack surface for SQL injection and brute-force attempts.
rules.remediation: Disable IPv4 public network assignment and configure Private IP (VPC Peering).
